name: Fetches Document
description: A process retrieves a web document over HTTP(S). Source is left wildcard so any fetcher (e.g. a CI workflow, a program) can fetch without computing_core depending on the fetcher's owning plugin. Renamed from the bare verb FETCHES on 2026-09-10 to name what is fetched; no `_FROM` because the target IS the object fetched, not its origin.
